title: Korean Face Solo #38 (한국 · 20대 · 섹시한 · 메이크업 없음 · 피어싱 P50+쥬얼리 · 마이크로더멀 투명 라운드 · 스티커 금박 별(관자놀이) · 각도 숙이고 올려보기)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, her head tilted slightly down with the chin tucked and her eyes looking up at the camera from beneath her brows, the camera at eye level, both ears still visible, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the base of her neck and the tops of her collarbones, the frame cutting off there. Her face is large and sharp. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a striking adult Korean woman — Korean fresh natural beauty luminous light-neutral complexion with a soft peach-beige undertone, mid 20s, hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most dramatic hourglass ratio ever, simultaneously maximum enormous bust AND maximum enormous hips both flaring to absolute impossible extremes while the waist is cinched to impossible minimum, glossy dark-brown loose waves past the shoulders. Real pores and fine skin grain on her skin, a soft sheen of natural oils, large eyes with bright real catchlights, full lips, microdermal clear round faceted gems pressed deep into the skin: a row of five small gems along each cheekbone and one larger gem at the center of the forehead, each gem sitting on a tiny hidden metal base implanted beneath the skin and pressing firmly down so the skin around every gem is visibly pushed in, forming a clear small dimple with a soft raised ring of flesh bulging around its edge, a small natural warm shadow in each dimple, calm healthy skin with no redness or swelling, all gems well clear of the eyes and clear of the piercings, four small gold foil star stickers, two at each temple, all stickers flat on the skin, clear of the eyes and lids and clear of the piercings, heavy-lidded eyes under half-lowered eyelids, lips slightly parted, a sultry, alluring expression — a photograph of a real Korean woman's face (East Asian Korean features: a slim V-line face with a small tapered chin and smooth forehead, large double-lidded eyes with soft fullness under them, a straight narrow nose bridge with a small rounded tip, softly full lips, gently straight eyebrows), not an illustration, not a render. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light 

Piercings: An extreme, dense array of large real metal piercings: a thick bronze septum ring with a smaller bronze ring above it and two bronze rings through each nostril; a straight bronze bar across the bridge of the nose between the brows; three thick bronze bars stacked through the outer half of each eyebrow; a bronze Medusa stud above the lips; a big bronze hoop, two smaller rings and a snake-bite ring on each side through the lower lip's edge, and a row of small hoops through the upper lip's edge; a bronze labret stud and two rings through the chin; a row of small bronze studs along each jaw; a curved row of small bronze studs along each cheekbone; on each ear a full dense row from lobe to top of oversized bronze hoops, thick bars and stretched plugs, the biggest hoops hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulders; and two fine bronze chains looping from the ear hoops to the nostril rings. Each piece carries small opals set into the metal. All jewelry is real bronze, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Jewelry: besides the piercings she wears four to six pieces, layered of mixed-metal necklaces and chains resting on her neck and collarbones, and four to six pieces, layered of mixed-metal hair ornaments set in her hair, all of it real, without covering her eyes, her face or her piercings.

Lighting: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal and every gem read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
